biomes.description: a vast arena of black basalt and star-veined marble, broken statues of former champions ringing the tiers, the Crown of Verdict suspended above the floor in still light
biomes.bright_description: a sunlit arena of pale stone and star-veined marble, banners drifting, a gentle crown of light held above a wide open floor
biomes.healing_visual: a figure standing on the floor without shrinking and without crushing anyone, the Crown of Verdict lowering by a hand's width

biomes.description: a floating city of lashed vessels riding the meeting of three currents — one clear and fast, one dark and cold, one silver-bright — a central platform laid with a mosaic of waves that only reads whole from every side
biomes.bright_description: a friendly floating town of colorful boats tied together where three sparkling streams meet, a round deck at the center paved with a wave mosaic
biomes.healing_visual: someone standing at the platform's center seeing the whole mosaic, all three currents feeding the same harbor

biomes.description: islands of cloudstone bound by lightning tethers, spires that cast one shared shadow, bridges of light between them, the distinct lands of the world visible far below
biomes.bright_description: soft cloud islands with airy towers and rainbow bridges, kites and gliders, the patchwork lands of the world visible below
biomes.healing_visual: the towers each casting their own shadow, bridges remaining but no longer chains, one figure flying under their own name

biomes.description: twelve warm islands joined by living root-bridges that pulse with light, the First Hearth burning steady at the center, lanterns on every shore
biomes.bright_description: twelve cozy islands with glowing root-bridges and a great warm hearth at the center, lanterns and blankets on every shore
biomes.healing_visual: a root-bridge stretching to make room without snapping, glowing brighter on an honest request, mending where it was torn
